##### Project general facts

Five Oceans Residence is an innovative residential project by Stetsyuk Development Group, an international developer with over a decade of experience creating high-quality assets across the United States, Indonesia, and Ukraine. Located in the vibrant heart of Canggu, this premium complex combines refined aesthetics, functional design, and a high-yield investment model. Designed for modern travelers, digital nomads, and families alike, the development offers a stylish and thoughtfully curated environment for living, working, and relaxing.

Residents enjoy access to a wealth of amenities designed to support a balanced and enriching lifestyle. The complex features a modern co-working space for productive days, a dedicated children's zone with professional nannies, and a restaurant and smoothie bar for daily dining or special occasions. A full-service spa and beauty salon, a barbershop, premium retail outlets, and a supermarket complete the offering. The centerpiece is a spacious and safe swimming pool area spanning generous grounds, providing a serene setting for relaxation.

Each residence at Five Oceans is crafted with uncompromising attention to quality, featuring premium finishes and contemporary design. From spacious apartments to one-, two-, and three-bedroom villas with private pools, every unit is designed for comfort and style. Interiors include fully equipped kitchens, inviting living areas, and well-appointed bedrooms and bathrooms. Villas are complemented by private pools, washing machines, and dishwashers, while a structural warranty ensures long-term peace of mind. Every detail reflects the developer's commitment to excellence.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the vibrant coastal area of Canggu within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents at the epicenter of Bali's most dynamic and sought-after lifestyle destination. Canggu has evolved into a global hub for digital nomads, wellness enthusiasts, and discerning travelers, offering a unique blend of world-class surf breaks, rice field vistas, and an eclectic dining and retail scene. Within a short radius, hundreds of cafes and restaurants serve cuisine from around the world, alongside boutique brands and concept showrooms for exclusive shopping.

The area is distinguished by its perfect balance of energy and tranquility. Residents enjoy close proximity to premier fitness clubs, international schools, and iconic beach clubs such as Atlas and Finns, while still being surrounded by the lush, scenic landscapes that define Bali's charm. The neighborhood's exceptional connectivity and growing infrastructure make it an ideal base for those seeking both adventure and convenience.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the essence of modern tropical living, Canggu delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its reputation as one of Bali's most desirable areas, combined with its thriving community and strong rental demand, makes it a prime location for both homeowners and investors. This is a place where contemporary convenience meets authentic island culture, an ideal setting for a vibrant, fulfilling life.
